shared_elements: pale limestone/stone surface carved in low relief
figures shown in profile facing sideways
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper part
row of small repeated signs or units
flat reserved background around raised motifs
justification: The most specific correspondence is the organisation of each surface into an upper horizontal band of small repeated units above a larger field of profile figures rendered in shallow flat relief on pale stone. The biggest differences are the support shapes (a rounded-topped tapering slab versus a broad-headed pillar with a narrow shaft) and the execution: A has fine, crisply incised interior detail and seated human figures with offerings, while B is coarse, rounded and modelled with only animal forms and a plain zigzag band.
